changes_vs_current: New topic. Raw average-position order (7 Harris years + YouGov popularity + YouGov fame + PPP; YouGov positions re-ranked within the ~70-name candidate pool) was: Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington, Johnny Depp, Brad Pitt, Sandra Bullock, Clint Eastwood, Morgan Freeman, Harrison Ford, Jennifer Lawrence, Keanu Reeves, Eddie Murphy, Jackie Chan, Jim Carrey, Will Smith, Bruce Lee, Robin Williams, Adam Sandler, Danny DeVito, Matt Damon, Samuel L. Jackson, Leonardo DiCaprio, Betty White, Marilyn Monroe, Robert Downey Jr., Michael J. Fox, Julia Roberts (26), Meryl Streep (27), ... John Wayne (30), George Clooney (34), Tom Cruise (36), Robert De Niro (~41).

John Wayne moved from raw #30 to #5: in the Harris top 10 in all 7 editions read (avg ~4.9, #2 in 2014); his raw rank is dragged down only by YouGov liking (#222), which skews young. Gut check had him top 12.

Meryl Streep moved from #27 to #10 and Julia Roberts from #26 to #11: Harris top 10 in 4 and 5 of 7 editions respectively, Streep #5 in PPP favorability; YouGov liking (#50, #62) is the only source lower. Both gut-check picks.

Morgan Freeman raised from #7 to #3: YouGov liking #1, PPP #3 (75% fav), gut check; Johnny Depp lowered from #3 to #8 because all his Harris strength predates 2016 and his current YouGov liking is #57 (67%).
Clint Eastwood moved up #6 -> #4 (Harris top 10 in all 7 editions, PPP #4).
Leonardo DiCaprio (gut check) placed #12 (raw #21): YouGov fame #4 and PPP 58% fav, but never in a Harris top 10 and YouGov liking #78, so kept at the edge of the top 12 rather than higher.

Tom Cruise (gut check) left at #18 (raw #36): PPP has him last of actors (34% fav / 43% unfav) and YouGov liking #195, though fame #8. Robert De Niro (gut check) at #20: no Harris appearance, YouGov liking #63, fame #23.
George Clooney moved up from raw #34 to #16 (Harris top 10 in 5 of 7 editions, PPP 62%). Will Smith kept around raw spot (#13): Harris twice, PPP #6, YouGov fame #1, but liking now #243.

Dropped despite raw top-24 spots, because their raw rank rests only on YouGov liking (no favorite-star poll mentions) and they are better known for TV/comedy or martial arts than as 'all-time greatest' picks: Jackie Chan (#12), Bruce Lee, Adam Sandler, Danny DeVito, Matt Damon, Betty White (TV), Robert Downey Jr., Michael J. Fox. Jackie Chan is the first out.
Alias notes: only one Hepburn would be eligible so 'hepburn' is unused (neither Hepburn made the 24); 'tom' and 'jennifer' deliberately not aliased (two Toms).

Review pass (coordinator gut check: Al Pacino, Jack Nicholson in top 12; De Niro/Monroe buried). Checked YouGov all-time actors & actresses Q3 2026: Pacino popularity #42 (69%) / fame #74 (90%); Nicholson popularity #64 (67%) / fame #82 (90%); De Niro popularity #63 (67%) / fame #23 (94%); Monroe popularity #35 (70%) / fame #7 (96%). Other liking data: 24/7 Tempo (YouGov) Nicholson #12, Pacino #15 of men; Stacker June 2024 (YouGov) Nicholson #20, Pacino #29 of men; PPP 2013 Nicholson 62% fav, behind 7 others. No public 'greatest actor of all time' poll (YouGov, Gallup, Talker) was found; the Ranker crowd vote 'Best Actors of All Time' could not be opened (HTTP 401), so it is not used.

Result: Pacino (#22) and Nicholson (#21) added, since their YouGov liking and fame put them in range of the tail. They are not in the top 12, because sources put them lower: neither appears in any of the 7 Harris favorite-star top 10s (2004-2015), YouGov fame has them at #74/#82, and PPP has Nicholson behind Hanks, Denzel, Freeman, Eastwood, Streep, Will Smith and Halle Berry. Marilyn Monroe moved #22 -> #17 (YouGov fame #7, liking #35) and Robert De Niro #20 -> #18 (fame #23): all-time framing; both still below Will Smith, Keanu, Clooney and Robin Williams on the data.

Dropped to make room: Jennifer Lawrence (was #15; Harris top 10 2013-15 and YouGov liking #20, but PPP only 41% fav and her Harris showings are a short current-star run, a poor fit for 'all-time') and Dwayne Johnson (was #23; YouGov liking #41 and fame #14 but no favorite-star poll mention). Samuel L. Jackson kept (YouGov liking #8, Stacker #2, 24/7 Tempo #9). The 'the rock'/'rock' aliases leave with Dwayne Johnson.
confidence: medium. The top 11 are well supported: Harris favorite-star polls (7 editions 2004-2015) and PPP favorability agree on Hanks, Denzel, Eastwood, Wayne, Pitt, Ford, Depp, Bullock, Streep, Roberts, and YouGov 2026 confirms Hanks/Denzel/Freeman. Doubts: the Harris series stopped after the 2015 survey so the open-ended 'favorite' data is 10+ years old (Depp and Will Smith have since lost favor; Wayne may be fading with younger adults); YouGov liking overrates TV/comedy figures; the 13-24 tail (Will Smith, Keanu, Clooney, Robin Williams, Monroe, De Niro, Cruise, Murphy, Nicholson, Pacino, Carrey, Samuel L. Jackson) is a judgement blend of YouGov fame/liking with no direct favorite poll. Brando, Bogart and Audrey Hepburn stay out (YouGov liking #188, #281, #47, never in a Harris top 10). There is no 'greatest actor' poll, so how well-regarded actors like Pacino and Nicholson are is only inferred.
